scope_notes: Public product pages do not completely define statistical metric, sampling, correction state or acceptance protocol. Numeric anchors are not asserted to be equivalent to the working Q metric.

Matching increments are disjoint residual buckets on top of the defined DCO baseline, not a second copy of each scanner's full error. This is a proposed bookkeeping model, not a universal physical identity.
Parent propagation uses random variance R squared, never the bias-including Q squared. B at each level is the total bound, not an additional independent branch.
Stage parent caps are used conservatively above the stage level; three child allocations close below their caps.
Product mask writing, product process distortion, etch shifts and measurement acceptance uncertainty require separate characterization. No product EPE or yield is certified.
